howItWorks.title: Ku eeg Shiinaha. Si xirfad leh u iibso. Waanu kuu keenaynaa.
howItWorks.subtitle: Isticmaal abka si aad uga iibsato 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods iyo JD — ChinaSuuq wuxuu qabtaa iibinta, hubinta, rarka iyo keenista albaabkaaga Soomaaliya.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fur abka oo sahmi 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods iyo JD — wakhtiga dhabta ah, oo leh turjumid Ingiriis iyo Soomaali ah oo ku dhex jira.
howItWorks.step2Title: Si xirfad leh u qabso alaab kasta
howItWorks.step2Desc: Taabo badhanka + ee alaab kasta oo aad jeceshahay, ama ku dhaqo link-ga alaabta. ChinaSuuq wuxuu si toos ah u ogaadaa qiimaha, sawirada, iyo noocyada.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Xulo midabka, cabirka, moodalka, iyo inta unug ee aad rabto. Barbardhig rarka diyaaradda (7-14 maalmood) iyo badda (25-40 maalmood) oo arag wadarta lacagta degaankaaga.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Dhamaystir bixitaanka ZAAD, eDahab, Premier Wallet, wareejinta bangiga, ama USDT. Waan xaqiijinnaa dalab kasta oo WhatsApp kahor inta aan iibin.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Kooxdayadu waxay ka iibisaan alaab-qeybiyeyaal Shiineed oo la xaqiijiyay, hubiyaan shay kasta oo ku saabsan bakhaarkayaga Shiinaha, oo wadaagtaa sawirro kahor inta aan rarnin.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Xulo qaadashada bakhaarkayaga Hargeisa ama keenidda oo dhan albaabka. Waanu qabannaa canshuuraha, isku-darka, iyo safarkii ugu dambeeyay ilaa cinwaankaaga.

shipping.title: Shixnad kasta ka arag bakhaarka ilaa Hargeysa.
shipping.subtitle: Dooro xawaaraha iyo cabbirka ku habboon dalabkaaga. Waanu isku geynaa, hubinnaa, oo kula socodsiinnaa ilaa aad qaadato ama guriga laguu keeno.
shipping.airDesc: Degdeg, fudud, iyo dalabyo waqti xasaasi ah.
shipping.airBest: Ku habboon muunado, dalabyo degdeg ah iyo xirmooyin yaryar
shipping.seaDesc: Ku habboon kartoonno, alaab guri iyo dalabyo badan.
shipping.seaBest: Ku habboon alaab culus iyo tiro badan
shipping.trackDesc: Dalabkaagu wuxuu maraa heerar cad — lacag-bixin, bakhaar, hubin, rarka, canshuur iyo keenid.
shipping.step1Desc: Lacagta waa la hubiyay, dalabkuna saf ayuu galay.
shipping.step2Desc: Alaabtii iibiyaha waa la helay oo la waafajiyay.
shipping.step3: La hubiyay oo la isku daray
shipping.step3Desc: Sawirro, hubin tayo iyo xirxirid wanaagsan.
shipping.step4Desc: Rarka diyaaradda ama badda ayaa ka baxay halka uu ka yimid.
shipping.step6Desc: Canshuurta iyo wareejinta gudaha ayaa socda.
shipping.step7Desc: Laanta ka qaado ama cinwaankaaga ha laguugu keeno.

about.title: Buundo wanaagsan oo isku xirta suuqyada Shiinaha iyo iibsadayaasha Somaliland.
about.subtitle: Waxaan kuu fududaynaynaa inaad alaab hesho, dalbato, oo aad si kalsooni leh u hesho — hal ab, hal koox iyo hal safar oo cad.
about.missionTitle: Waxaa loo dhisay sida dadku dhab ahaan u iibsadaan
about.missionDesc: ChinaSuuq wuxuu macaamiisha Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland ku xiraa ganacsiga ballaaran ee Shiinaha, iyadoo aan lagu qasbin inay kaligood xalliyaan luqad, iibiyaha, lacag-bixin iyo rar.
about.warehouseDesc: Macaamiishu suuqyada ayay iyagu ka baaraan. Annagu waxaan ka caawinnaa dalabka, iibka, helitaanka bakhaarka Shiinaha, hubinta iyo doorashada jidka rarka.
about.value1Desc: Ka baadho 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods iyo JD gudaha khibradda alaabta.
about.value2Desc: Ogow waxa dhacay, waxa xiga iyo halka shixnaddu marayso.
about.value3Desc: La hadal koox Soomaali ku hadasha WhatsApp iyo kanaallada gudaha.
about.value4Desc: Hubin, sawirro iyo isku-darid ka hor inta alaabta laga dirin Shiinaha.
about.storyTitle: Shiinaha ilaa Hargeysa, si dhab ah loo fududeeyay
about.storyDesc: ChinaSuuq wuxuu dhisayaa kaabayaasha maalinlaha ah ee ka dhigaya iibsiga xuduudaha inuu u ekaado mid gudaha ah: abka ka hel, koox bini’aadan ah xaqiiji, dabadeed Somaliland ku hel.
